findings.summary: Disabled tab is not skipped by arrow-key movement (reported on v1.5.0); closed, but we still saw a disabled tab take focus on the version installed here.
Request to allow disabled tabs to be skipped during keyboard navigation.
Focus goes to the panel rather than focusable content inside it.
Update-depth loop when Tabs.Tab renders a router Link (1.7.0 regression); m3 does not use render links.
Incorrect rendering of Tabs with base UI (title only seen, details not read).

notChecked: Reddit, Hacker News and blog searches

differences.where: default tabs, line tabs, vertical tabs (arrow keys)
differences.reference: Arrow keys move focus and select the tab immediately (automatic activation); panel switches.
differences.branch: Arrow keys only move focus; tab is not selected until Enter/Space (activateOnFocus is false by default); the panel does not change.
differences.how: Click Account, press ArrowRight. Reference: Password selected and panel shows Password panel. Branch: focus on Password, Account still selected.

differences.reference: Disabled trigger is a native button with disabled attribute: not focusable, skipped by arrow keys, End goes to Password.
differences.branch: Disabled trigger has aria-disabled=true and no disabled attribute; arrow keys land focus on it, and End stays on it (it is last).
differences.how: Click Account, ArrowRight twice, then End. Reference: focus cycles Password, Account; End goes to Password. Branch: focus lands on Disabled.

differences.where: all tab lists, tab order / roving tabindex
differences.reference: Tablist has tabindex 0 and role tablist with aria-orientation; triggers use roving tabindex tied to focus.
differences.branch: Tablist has no tabindex or aria-orientation; the active tab gets tabindex 0 at rest (data-composite-item-active).

data-active, data-activation-direction, data-index, data-composite-item-active; no data-state. The registry file renames Content to Panel and Trigger to Tab, and adds aria-disabled: classes to the trigger.
differences.how: Compare outerHTML of the first Tabs in the section.

apiChanges: TabsPrimitive.Trigger becomes Tab and Content becomes Panel inside tabs.tsx; prop types become TabsPrimitive.*.Props; onValueChange gets (value, eventDetails). Gallery.tsx and DisplaySections.tsx would need no edit (typecheck passed with the swap applied). Not applied.
notes: Resting visuals at 1280x900 looked identical in dark mode (default, line, vertical). Typecheck passed with the swap, then the file was restored. 390x844: the resize did not change the screenshot frame (still 1280 wide), so mobile was not checked. Hover and press screenshots, reduced motion and the line/vertical keyboard checks were not run separately.
reasonNotMoved: Base UI Tabs behaves differently from Radix: arrow keys move focus without selecting (Radix selects), and the disabled trigger is focusable via aria-disabled and not skipped (Radix uses native disabled). Retry once the swap can set activateOnFocus on Tabs.List and keep disabled triggers non-focusable, then re-run the arrow, End and Tab checks against https://m3.khojlabs.com/gallery#components; keep the migration only if the keyboard results match.
